cases.sentence: На ___ Иоанн увидел идущего к нему Иисуса и сказал:
cases.explain: «следующий день» — after the preposition «на», the accusative marks the direct object of the verb.
cases.translation: The next day, he saw Jesus coming to him, and said, “Behold, the Lamb of God, who takes away the sin of the world!

cases.sentence: На ___ Иоанн опять стоял с двумя своими учениками.
cases.explain: «следующий день» — after the preposition «на», the accusative marks the direct object of the verb.
cases.translation: Again, the next day, John was standing with two of his disciples,

cases.sentence: На ___ Иисус решил идти в Галилею.
cases.explain: «следующий день» — after the preposition «на», the accusative marks the direct object of the verb.
cases.translation: On the next day, he was determined to go out into Galilee, and he found Philip. Jesus said to him, “Follow me.”
